name: 16:8 Intermittent Fasting
summary: 16-hour fasting window with 8-hour eating window for metabolic health

actions.name: Stop eating by 8 PM
actions.description: Last food by 8 PM. This starts your fasting window. Water, black coffee, plain tea are allowed during the fast.

actions.name: Maintain fast until noon
actions.description: No calories until 12 PM. Black coffee and water are fine. If hungry, drink water or have green tea.

actions.name: First meal at 12 PM
actions.description: Break fast with a balanced meal. Include protein. Don't binge — eat normally.

actions.name: All food in 8-hour window
actions.description: Eat all meals and snacks between 12 PM and 8 PM. 2-3 meals is typical. No need to restrict what you eat, but don't compensate by overeating.

customization.eating_window: Adjust window to your schedule (e.g., 10 AM - 6 PM). Consistency matters more than exact hours.
customization.workout_timing: If training fasted, consider BCAAs or breaking fast slightly earlier on workout days.

notes: First week is hardest. Morning hunger fades after adaptation. Stay hydrated. Start with 14:10 if 16:8 feels too aggressive.
